long_biography.plain_text:
At Benteks in Istanbul, Mark Benmayor occupied the chairman’s role in a specialist textile-machinery distributor. The company supplied sewing and knitting equipment, needles and spare parts, added technical service, and represented German manufacturer Groz-Beckert across knitting, felting, tufting and sewing applications.

The agency role placed Benmayor between international equipment makers and Turkey’s textile producers, translating specialist machinery into local sales and support. He later joined fellow textile businessman Albert Benmayor and former cinema executive Adnan Akdemir in an investment in packaging-waste recycling. The move added an environmental-services venture to his established machinery interests.
